summary: Frontend testing completed for RegistraTEAM volleyball club management app. Verified that: 1) Frontend loads correctly without build errors, 2) Icons render correctly using emoji-based custom Icon component across all pages, 3) Back arrow navigation icons work in headers, 4) Fiscal receipt API endpoint responds correctly with data. Fixed 2 remaining files that still used @expo/vector-icons imports, and added missing expand/contract icons to the Icon component.

issues: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated warning appearing - should use 'boxShadow' instead
Unexpected text node warnings in React Native Views - cosmetic issue

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: ImageCropper.tsx and PhotoViewer.tsx were still importing from @expo/vector-icons - now use custom Icon component
Added: expand, expand-outline, contract, contract-outline icons to Icon.tsx for PhotoViewer functionality
Note: All Ionicons references now use emoji-based Icon component - this is the permanent solution as @expo/vector-icons doesn't work reliably on Expo Web
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend icons are now using emoji-based Icon component (/app/frontend/src/components/Icon.tsx). All Ionicons imports should point to this custom component. Login API works but browser session testing requires proper authentication flow.
